content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-infrastructure-reality-check|USDT Payment]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators-2|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

This stack is perfect for selling music online and accepting Bitcoin, as it eliminates the need for intermediaries and allows you to keep 99.5% of your revenue – compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack that works in 2025 is a combination of Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack is scalable, secure, and cost-effective, and it allows you to sell music online and accept Bitcoin without relying on intermediaries like Gumroad or PayPal.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

You don't need to worry about SPFs, DKIMs, or DMARCs yet – these are advanced security measures that can be implemented later. What you need to focus on right now is deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to sell music online and accept Bitcoin. With the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), you can get started in 48 hours and start selling your music online today.

Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, you need to set up NOWPayments on your Cloudflare Pages or Google Sites, configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and add your music files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Once you've completed these steps, you can test your payment flow and start selling your music online – all without relying on intermediaries like Gumroad or PayPal.
